thread:
chris: Heads-up: deploy-bot failed to publish image to eu-prod ECR. Attestation/provenance mismatch across mirror regions, deploy halted. logs: deploy-bot: publish failed: provenance-signature-region-mismatch (code 422). Need a plan for retag/pin during change window. @nina @alex

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: release 2026.03.20-rc3 aborted for service inference-api. Failed: provenance verification failed for digest sha256:abcd1234efgh... Mirrors: us/eu differ. Attempted fallback to signed-mirror but rejected.

nina: On it. grabbing logs + verifying cosign signatures. curious if GCR mirror has same attestation id.

alex: If attestation TTL skew is root cause, we can retag to a temporary tag with same digest and force-apply attestation from signing pipeline. But need change window approval — we are in peak traffic.

ryan: We should avoid retagging published digests unless absolutely necessary. Alternative: pin deployment to the already-running digest (sha256:abcd1234efgh...), roll forward blocked, force promote existing image into next canary slot until we resolve provenance.

chris: Agree with pin+promote. Ops: can we create a short-lived alias tag 'hotfix/prov-20260320' that points to digest, and patch k8s manifests to use that tag across EU? That avoids rebuild.

nina: cosign show --manifest sha256:abcd1234efgh... shows 2 attestations with differing timestamp fields. Looks like mirror rewriting timestamps. I'll coordinate with registry team. For now I can run:
```
aws ecr batch-check-layer-availability --repository-name inference-api --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:abcd1234efgh...
gcloud container images describe eu.gcr.io/my-project/inference-api@sha256:abcd1234efgh...
```
to confirm mirrors.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created rollback plan: if no resolution within 30m, auto-rollback to previous stable digest sha256:1234abcd5678... and notify #incidents.

alex: :warning: Need approvals to tag/push during change window. @eng-releases can we get 2 approvals? @maya?

maya: Approved for emergency tag push and short-lived alias. Keep me posted, I'll join for manual verification.

chris: Plan: nina to attempt reattestation -> alex to apply alias tag if successful -> ryan to trigger a canary promote -> wait 10m metrics -> rollout. If fails, deploy-bot will rollback. I'll update release notes and notify customers if rollback.

nina: Reattestation completed, cosign apply OK. Pushed 'hotfix/prov-20260320' -> `aws ecr put-image --repository-name inference-api --image-tag hotfix/prov-20260320 --image-manifest <manifest>` . Verified in eu region. :thumbsup:

ryan: Promote canary now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary promote started for inference-api -> 5% in EU. Observability: latency/5m within SLO.

chris: :shipit: Closing thread. Will follow up with release notes + postmortem if root cause is mirror timestamp rewrite.
